purpose: Machine-readable plumbing design/checking rules derived from code structure and publicly accessible code information.

rules.condition: Potable water system has an unprotected cross-connection to a nonpotable source.
Water distribution sizing does not use the UPC's applicable sizing method/tables or approved engineering method.
rules.action: Recalculate demand and pipe sizes using the applicable UPC method.

rules.condition: Hot-water recirculation/system arrangement is inconsistent with the applicable UPC provisions.
rules.action: Verify recirculation, temperature control and equipment arrangement.
rules.source_note: IAPMO identifies updated hot-water recirculating provisions in 2024.
